ops-squad: Quick heads-up — the scheduled control-plane patch that started at 2024-07-12 02:00 UTC finished early at 02:27 UTC. No customer-facing errors reported during or after the window. :tada:
statusbot: [automated] Maintenance job #MP-482 completed. All health checks green.
oncall-max: I validated model routing, KV cache warmed, and canary traffic passed smoke for 15m. No throttles.
amelia: Nice — thanks for the verification. Can we post a short status page update as 'resolved' and send a brief customer note?
support-josh: I'll prep a CS blurb. Suggest keeping it concise: what we did, that customers saw no impact, and who to contact.
product-kate: +1. Also flag that feature rollout 2.3 will still proceed tomorrow; nothing to block that.
ops-squad: Drafts below. Please review and 👍 / suggest edits. If no objections, I'll publish the status update and queue the customer email.

status page suggested copy (short):
```
Component: Control Plane (API routing)
Status: Resolved
Timeline: Maintenance started 02:00 UTC, completed 02:27 UTC
Impact: No customer-facing impact observed. Internal validation and canary traffic passed.
Notes: Routine control-plane patch and routing kernel optimizations. For questions contact status@redwood.ai
```

customer notification draft (email / portal notice):
```
Subject: Maintenance complete — control-plane patch (no impact observed)

Hello,

We completed a routine control-plane patch today (started 02:00 UTC, completed 02:27 UTC). Our post-deploy checks and canary traffic validation show no customer-facing impact. If you noticed any unexpected behavior, please reply to this message or open a support ticket.

Thanks,
The Redwood Inference Ops Team
```

internal Slack template (for #general / #customers):
```
@here Maintenance complete: control-plane patch finished early (02:27 UTC). No impact seen. CS on standby for any reports. Ops and oncall will run postmortem checklist and share notes by EOD.
```

ops-squad: Action items
- Publish status page update as Resolved (ops-squad)
- Send customer portal/email using above draft (support-josh)
- Run post-deploy metric sweep and attach graphs to incident log (oncall-max, engbot)
- Security quick-check for cert/key rotations touched by deploy (security-liz)
- Capture a short postmortem / rollout notes and link in internal doc (amelia)

oncall-max: I kicked off the metric sweep and will attach latency/token-cost charts to the thread when ready. Early glance shows no regressions.
security-liz: I'll validate KMS/HSM logs and rotation actions, will flag if anything requires follow-up.
engbot: Canary traces: 02:10-02:40 window OK, no 5xx spikes. Logs: `grep -n "ERROR" control-plane/2024-07-12.log | wc -l` => 0
support-josh: I'll draft the customer email and ping legal if we need any additional language. Posting in 10m.
amelia: Gentle reminder — please tag the ticket with MP-482 for tracking so the billing and product ops teams can reconcile.
ops-squad: Thanks all. If anyone sees customer reports after the message goes out, tag @oncall-max and @ops-squad immediately. Otherwise I'll close the maintenance incident this afternoon after the postmortem note is attached. :white_check_mark:
